subject: Pricing follow-up: context length + token volume profile (post-demo)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 14:00:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing follow-up: context length + token volume profile (post-demo)

Hi Alex —

Great to meet you and the team on today's demo. Quick recap and a few asks so Rachel (solutions engineer) and I can put together a pricing + capacity plan tailored to Acme's usage profile.

Recap (from our call)
- Primary use case: long-form summarization + multi-turn assistant for customer support + some code-assist flows.
- Target go-live: Q3 2026 pilot; production by end of year.
- Expected growth: pilot ~5M tokens/month ramping to ~40–60M tokens/month in 12 months.

To size Dedicated vs Hosted and produce an accurate unit-cost estimate, can you confirm the following token/context breakdowns? A few numbers will be enough — approximate averages are fine.

Ask (please reply inline)
1) Average prompt tokens per request (examples: 40, 120, 500)
2) Average completion tokens per request (examples: 50, 300, 1,200)
3) Percent of requests that require:
   - <=8k context (short)
   - >8k and <=32k (mid)
   - >32k and <=128k (long)
4) Monthly token volume today and target in 6 / 12 months (pilot -> production)
5) Target unit economics (what would you consider an acceptable $/1M tokens for budgeting?)
6) Any hard SLAs or latency targets (p99, interactive vs background jobs)

Attachments: If you have a sample export (token-profile by route or a small CSV) that would be super helpful. I'm attaching a draft mutual action plan so we can align on timelines and procurement steps.

Proposed next steps
- Rachel to run a short technical sizing / cost model based on your numbers.
- Follow-up call next week to review pricing scenarios (Hosted vs Dedicated, caching/batching impacts).
- I’ll include an initial estimate for $/1M tokens at 8k/32k/128k profile brackets.

Thanks — appreciate any rough numbers and happy to iterate.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan_draft.pdf]

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: context length + token volume profile (post-demo)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap — great demo. Answers below (rough averages from analytics + product team):

1) Average prompt tokens: ~120 tokens (most prompts include a short user message + 1–2 KB of context metadata, ~80–150 tokens typical).
2) Average completion tokens: ~850 tokens (summaries range widely; mean ~600–900; some long summarizations hit 2k–4k).
3) Percent requests by context bracket (estimates):
   - <=8k: ~95% (typical support & short-assistant flows)
   - >8k and <=32k: ~4% (multi-doc summarize + legal/contract assist)
   - >32k and <=128k: ~1% (full-document summarization for long contracts / policy bundles)
4) Monthly token volume: today ~5M tokens/month; pilot target ~12–15M/month; 12-month target ~50M/month.
5) Target unit economics: for budgeting we'd like to target roughly $800 / 1M tokens (this is the internal target cost that buying/infra should aim for). If you can show a plan that gets to $600–$900 / 1M at scale that'd be ideal.
6) SLAs/latency: interactive p95 <= 800ms where possible for support flows; longer jobs (summaries) can be async with SLAs in minutes.

I've attached a small token export (anonymized) for a week of traffic. Procurement is on copy — procurement timeline is flexible but would like pricing + MA/contract draft by mid-March.

Thanks,
Alex
Product Lead | Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com | +1 617-555-0199
[Attachment: ACME_token_profile_202602.csv]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: context length + token volume profile (post-demo)

Alex — really helpful, thanks for the detail and the export. Quick notes and next steps:

- Summary of your numbers (for internal modeling): avg prompt ~120; avg completion ~850; volume today 5M -> pilot 12–15M -> 50M in 12 months; context needs: 95% <=8k, 4% 8–32k, 1% 32–128k. Target $/1M tokens ~ $800.
- This profile suggests a hybrid approach: Hosted for early pilot (faster time-to-value) and consideration for Dedicated capacity once you consistently hit 30–40M tokens/month to optimize unit cost and provide predictable throughput.
- We can leverage prefix/KV caching and dynamic batching to reduce effective unit cost on the 95% short-context traffic — that will impact your blended $/1M.

Rachel — can you prepare two cost scenarios for the follow-up call:
  A) Hosted: pricing bands at 8k/32k/128k with expected blended $/1M (pilot vs production).
  B) Dedicated: reserved capacity economics (commit vs burst) and how much committed throughput is needed to hit ~$600–$900 / 1M.

Alex / Procurement — are you available next Wed 10am PT or Thu 11am PT for a 45-min technical/pricing review? I’ll share a short slide with the assumptions we’ll model.

I’ll also put together a short one-page explainer showing how caching/batching/quantization choices affect unit cost so procurement has visibility on tradeoffs.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: ACME pricing prep (deal ACME-2026-02-25-01)

Rachel —

Thread id: ACME-2026-02-25-01 (from Alex). Key asks for the next call:
- Build Hosted vs Dedicated cost model for the provided profile (avg prompt 120 / completion 850; 95% <=8k, 4% 8–32k, 1% 32–128k).
- Show blended $/1M tokens for pilot (12–15M) and scale (50M). Target to present scenarios that hit $600, $800, $1000 per 1M tokens.
- Highlight the levers: batching, prefix/KV caching, quantization, and routing (fallback to cheaper variants).
- Prepare recommended committed throughput for Dedicated to reach $600–$900 / 1M at steady state.

Attach the sample export and the mutual action plan drafts (in thread). Procurement asked for a mid-March timeline for contract draft.

Can you put the draft slides + simple spreadsheet in the linked Drive doc by Tue EOD so I can share with Alex before the call?
